translations.web: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
translations.bsb: All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.
translations.kjv: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save
translations.asv: Our eyes do yet fail in looking for our vain help: In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
